title: WorkPulse overtime.rejected v1
description: An overtime request was rejected from `requested`, `manager_approved` or `hr_verified`. Identifiers, the work date, hours, the deciding actor and the source state only — the reason and notes are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/security.md`).

employee_id.description: Employee the request belongs to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

work_date.description: The single day the overtime was worked (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

hours.description: Requested overtime hours as a JSON number (ADR 0017); 0 < hours <= 12 with at most 2 decimal places. A count, never an amount.

rejected_by.description: Actor user id that rejected the request (ADR 0010 — never the requester).

rejected_from.description: The observed prior state; `hr_verified` is the un-verify window ADR 0018's finalize rollback assumes.
